correctness.rationale: Write p=max(0,m-1)+epsilon. For m in (1,2) each of k maximum observations contributes epsilon^{m-2+epsilon}, so L diverges; for m>2 it tends to zero; for m<1 prefactor gives L~p^n prod(1-x_i)^{-1}->0. For fixed xi and p->infinity, each density tends to e^{-xi}, making positive large-p alternative. Thus boundary cannot maximize in open parameter space for any m>1 and is not even a limiting maximum for m<1 or >2. Printed observations yield two reported boundary MLEs with lower reported log-likelihood than same likelihood at p=20 (-44.4075>-49.20; -104.3629>-126.50), as derived by the source checker. Independently rederived sample endpoint trichotomy and Pr(M20>2)=0.94122822985 in reported simulation regime. m=1 and m=2 deliberately outside displayed trichotomy (zero probability under continuous model).
